facts.contactOnly: See their Berkeley ordering page for the current drinks, options and prices. Regional contact details and the location of each review are below.

panels.head: NorCal contact

panels.head: Tea and mocktail experiences
body: Their October 24 regional post lists Berkeley Lishan mocktails Friday and Saturday, 6–9:30pm. These are mocktail service hours, not the shop’s general opening hours. Confirm current service and reservations with the team.
